contact.faq_subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions from our shoppers.

faqs.q: What is the standard delivery timeframe?
faqs.a: Orders within Hanoi & HCMC arrive in 1-2 business days. Other provinces take 3-5 business days via our courier partners GHN / GHTK.

faqs.q: How can I track my shipment?
faqs.a: Log in to your account and visit 'Orders' to check tracking info, or ask our AI Assistant directly for instant tracking updates.

faqs.q: Can I edit or cancel my placed order?
faqs.a: If your order has not been dispatched yet, you can contact our hotline or chat with customer support immediately to request adjustments or cancellation.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you support?
faqs.a: We support Cash on Delivery (COD), international credit/debit cards, and bank transfers via instant QR code.

returns.title: Returns & Exchanges Policy & Portal
returns.subtitle: Hassle-free 7-day returns & exchanges with dedicated customer care from Synapse.
returns.policy_time_desc: Applicable within 7 calendar days from the day your parcel was successfully delivered.
returns.policy_condition_desc: Items must be unwashed, unworn, in original packaging with tags attached, and with all accessories included.
returns.policy_fee_desc: Free 1-way shipping for your first size/color exchange. 100% free two-way shipping for manufacturing defects or incorrect deliveries.
returns.policy_exceptions_desc: Items discounted by 40% or more (Flash Sale/Final Clearance) and electronic gift cards cannot be returned or refunded.
returns.step_1_desc: Fill out the online request form below or chat directly with our AI Assistant.
returns.step_2_desc: Pack your items safely; our courier partner will pick them up directly at your address.
returns.step_3_desc: Our team inspects item conditions within 24-48 hours upon arrival at the warehouse.
returns.step_4_desc: We dispatch the replacement item immediately or process your refund to the original payment method.
returns.portal_desc: Enter your order information below to generate an RMA return ticket and arrange pickup.
returns.reason_color: Change color or choose a different model
returns.exchange_target_label: Target item or size for exchange (if exchanging)
returns.exchange_target_placeholder: e.g. Exchange Sweatshirt Size M to Size L in Black
returns.notes_placeholder: Please provide details about the fit issue or defect location...
returns.pickup_address_placeholder: e.g. 123 Nguyen Trai Street, Thanh Xuan, Hanoi
returns.success_desc: Your RMA Reference Code is: {rmaCode}. Our support team will contact you within 2 business hours to confirm courier pickup details.
returns.need_instant_help: Need urgent sizing or exchange advice?

faqs.q: Can I try items before accepting?
faqs.a: You can visually inspect the parcel upon delivery. After receiving, you have 7 full days to try at home and request size exchanges.

faqs.q: When will I receive my replacement item?
faqs.a: As soon as the courier picks up the return package and condition is verified, your replacement will be dispatched within 2-3 business days.

faqs.q: How does the refund process work?
faqs.a: When replacement is unavailable or for eligible refunds, money is refunded directly to your original bank account or card within 2-5 business days.
